messages:
maria: Quick sync — I'm blocked on merging feature-X because multiple repos need coordinated changes: redwood/sdk#1284, redwood/api#3422, redwood/console#776, charts/helm#55. Can we align approvals and merge order? :wave:
kevin: I can take the SDK review today, aiming to finish by EOD. Ping me on comments.
alex: Console depends on an API feature flag. If API doesn't add the flag we'll need a toggle in console. @maria what's the desired default behavior?
maria: default=false (opt-in). API needs a small response schema change — @kevin will SDK handle an optional new field?
kevin: SDK is backward compatible, will accept an optional field and not break clients.
jess: Helm chart bump depends on runtime image tag from eng-runtime. runtime PR open: redwood/runtime#901 — image built but not yet promoted to prod tag.
sara: I can promote the image once runtime CI passes smoke tests. there's one flaky e2e failing right now, I'll rerun and follow up.
ci-bot: SDK CI: all checks passed ✅
deploy-bot: API CI: failing integration tests — timeout in auth-middleware (known flaky). Recommend rerun. :thinking:
kevin: I'll rerun the api unit/integration job and pull logs; if it's the auth flake we can retry without code changes.
maria: Proposed plan: kevin finishes SDK review by 16:00, alex approves console once API flag lands, sara promotes runtime image by 17:00, then we merge API at 17:30 and cascade merges for console + sdk + helm. Canary rollout for 30m. Sound ok?
alex: ok from console side, will hold approvals until API merged and flag present.
jess: prepping helm PR with new image tag and will add canary annotation to chart values.
maria: tagging reviewers: @kevin @alex @jess — please add :eyes: to your PRs. If anyone wants a pairing review, ping me.
kevin: SDK is ready for final review, left one tiny comment (nits).
sara: runtime e2e passed on rerun, image promoted -> tag v2026-03-17-featureX
jess: updated helm PR with image tag v2026-03-17-featureX and canary policy in values.yaml
deploy-bot: API CI re-run passed ✅
maria: merging API now, will post merge sha and next steps.
maria: merged redwood/api#3422 -> sha abcdef1
alex: approving console now and kicking off CI, will merge after green builds.
kevin: merged redwood/sdk#1284 (no breaking changes)
jess: helm chart merged, canary applied; watching rollout dashboards.
maria: starting canary rollout, watching metrics and consumer-errors channel for 30m :rocket:
ci-bot: Canary checks: latency within baseline, error-rate stable
maria: Canary looks clean — promoting to full rollout in 10m
sara: promoting runtime image to prod tag and invalidating any relevant caches
maria: full rollout complete, no regressions or alerts. Great job everyone :tada:
